import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule';

@Injectable()
export class CompliantTask {
  constructor(private readonly jobs: { enqueue(type: string): Promise<void> }) {}

  @Cron('0 3 * * *')
  async tick(): Promise<void> {
    await this.jobs.enqueue('housekeeping.compliant');
  }
}
